Five-card draw it is. Table rules: each of us gets five cards face-down, then there's a round of betting. After that you can discard up to three cards (four if you keep an Ace) and draw replacements. There's one last round of betting, then the showdown. Hands rank the usual way, and a tie splits the pot.

You start with 1,000 chips. We each put in a 10-chip ante, so there are 20 in the pot. You have a pair of sevens. It's your move: check, bet 20 or fold.
